say: Profile loses its state on every Page render. Why?
explanation: withUser returns a new function each time it runs. React sees a different component type every render, so it unmounts the old tree and mounts a fresh one. Wrap once, outside Page.
explainSay: Each render creates a brand new component type, so React remounts it and its state is lost. Call the wrapper once, outside the component.
